author: Bobby Grayson
title: Lock via protocol simulation with <=1 deferred tick per waiting client: covers the await-state deferral and the grant cascade; BEAM twin traces the server's receives (:erlang.trace receive), waits for exactly the simulated messages in order, then :sys.get_state on the server and on unblocked clients; a queued client is reported waiting from the server's queue (it is blocked in the call and cannot answer a system message)
